name: 60142 · Huntley, IL
findings: ZIP 60142 (Huntley) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60142 (Huntley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60142 (Huntley) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).
